newsitem.title: UK: UK meals/feeds down at close but tradeless.
newsitem.headline: UK meals/feeds down at close but tradeless.

text.p: UK meals and feed closed without trading following a day where sellers searched in vain for the buyers, traders said.

Sterling's strength against a number of currencies and a lower close on Friday on the Chicago soybean meal futures, resulted in sellers dropping their prices but even that failed to spark any buying interest, they added.
Soybean meal values at the close were two to three sterling per tonne down on Friday, with rapemeal, sunflower pellets and sunflower meal lower by two sterling per tonne.
